Done. Summary:

- **`out/T5/solution.py`**: loads base Pythia-1B and the LoRA adapter, groups `lora_A`/`lora_B` pairs by base tensor name via the `base_model.model.` prefix strip, computes `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2`, merges `weight += scale * (B @ A)` in float32 then casts back to float16, runs all four required checks (16 pairs merged, no `lora_` names leak, `layers.0...query_key_value.weight` shape `[6144, 2048]`, 244 total tensors), then shards by cumulative tensor-byte size (≤512 MiB per shard, oversized embedding tensors get their own shard) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran it once (single execution, as required) — succeeded, produced 244 tensors across 4 shards, all ≤512 MiB.
- Wrote `out/T5/REPORT.md` with the self-report.
